title: Debt & coverage
summary: Use evidence-backed findings and multiple verification dimensions.

sections.label: Workplace state
sections.text: Actual technical debt and coverage are unknown until repositories and execution evidence are inspected. The categories here are an investigation plan.

sections.label: Operating method
sections.text: Collect specific findings, deduplicate, prioritize consequences and break remediation into reviewable outcomes. Avoid flooding the issue tracker with every static-analysis finding.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
